t: Analysis: What the Valmora summit means for small island states
d: Analysis: The Valmora flood-defence agreement is a genuine step forward, but its contribution formula and ratification timetable leave small island communities exposed.

t: Coastal Cities Alliance agrees €40bn flood-defence fund at Valmora summit
d: Delegates from 42 coastal cities have agreed a €40bn flood-defence fund at the Valmora summit, committing to a ten-year programme of sea walls, wetland restoration and early-warning systems.

t: Aurelia's parliament passes Digital Services Transparency Bill after marathon debate
d: After a 14-hour debate, Aurelia's parliament has passed the Digital Services Transparency Bill, requiring large online platforms to disclose how recommendation systems rank news and political content.

t: Meridian City clinch league title with last-minute winner
d: Meridian City won their first league title in 31 years after substitute Tomas Vidal scored a 94th-minute winner in a 2-1 victory over Harbour United.

t: Isla Verde ferry link restored after five-year closure
d: A passenger ferry between Isla Verde and the mainland has resumed service after a five-year closure caused by storm damage to the island's harbour.

t: Northwind Energy posts record quarter as offshore wind output surges
d: Northwind Energy reported record quarterly revenue, up 23%, driven by a surge in offshore wind output, while warning about supply-chain pressures on turbine components.

t: Why the four-day week debate is really about trust
d: Column: The four-day week debate is framed as a question of productivity, but it is really a question of whether employers trust their employees.

t: Regulator fines app developer €12m over location data practices
d: Aurelia's data protection regulator has fined the developer of a popular weather app €12m after finding it collected precise location data in the background and shared it with advertising partners.

t: Study links urban tree cover to fewer summer heat deaths
d: A ten-year study of 90 city districts by the Valmora Institute finds that neighbourhoods with more than 30% tree cover recorded significantly fewer deaths during heatwaves.

t: Opposition unveils 500,000-home plan ahead of Aurelia's regional elections
d: Aurelia's main opposition party has unveiled a plan to deliver 500,000 homes over eight years, centred on converting vacant offices and releasing public land for housing cooperatives.

t: Aurelian Central Bank holds rates steady, signals patience on inflation
d: The Aurelian Central Bank left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.25% for a fourth consecutive meeting, saying it needs more evidence that services inflation is easing.

t: Lumen 3 open-source language model released under permissive licence
d: The Lumen Foundation has released Lumen 3, a 40-billion-parameter open-source language model under a permissive licence, saying it can run on a single workstation GPU.

t: Researchers map deep-sea coral reef discovered off Isla Verde
d: Scientists have completed the first detailed map of a cold-water coral reef off Isla Verde, an 11-kilometre structure at depths of up to 600 metres that appears largely undamaged.

t: Valmora marathon record falls as shoe technology debate intensifies
d: Nadia Keller set a new Valmora Marathon course record of 2:16:41, reigniting debate over whether advanced running-shoe technology is distorting results.
